title: Creator campaign webhooks
content:
# Creator campaign webhooks

Receive an event when a creator asks to join or joins, sends a draft, requests a sample, submits a post, becomes payable or gets paid.

## Events

| Event | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`campaign_submission.received`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-submission-received) | A creator submitted a post and its tracking window opened. |
| [`campaign_submission.flagged`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-submission-flagged) | A submission gained a fraud flag it did not carry before. |
| [`campaign_submission.pending_review`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-submission-pending-review) | A submission is ready for your review. |
| [`campaign_submission.approved`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-submission-approved) | You approved a submission. |
| [`campaign_submission.rejected`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-submission-rejected) | You rejected a submission. |
| [`creator_campaign.budget_exhausted`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/creator-campaign-budget-exhausted) | Earnings reached the campaign budget. |
| [`creator_campaign.closed`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/creator-campaign-closed) | A campaign closed. |
| [`campaign_payout.payable`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-payout-payable) | Held earnings became payable. |
| [`campaign_payout.settled`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-payout-settled) | A payout was recorded. |
| [`campaign_payout.failed`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-payout-failed) | A treasury payout did not reach the creator. |
| [`campaign_participant.joined`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-participant-joined) | A creator joined a campaign. |
| [`campaign_participant.pending`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-participant-pending) | A creator asked to join a campaign that reviews creators. |
| [`campaign_participant.approved`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-participant-approved) | You accepted a creator who asked to join. |
| [`campaign_participant.denied`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-participant-denied) | You turned down a creator who asked to join. |
| [`campaign_participant.suspended`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-participant-suspended) | You suspended a participant. |
| [`campaign_participant.removed`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-participant-removed) | You removed a participant. |
| [`campaign_draft.submitted`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-draft-submitted) | A creator uploaded a draft or a new version of one. |
| [`campaign_draft.approved`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-draft-approved) | You approved a draft. |
| [`campaign_draft.revision_requested`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-draft-revision-requested) | You asked for changes to a draft. |
| [`campaign_draft.rejected`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-draft-rejected) | You rejected a draft. |
| [`campaign_sample.requested`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-sample-requested) | A creator asked for a product sample. |
| [`campaign_sample.approved`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-sample-approved) | You approved a sample request. |
| [`campaign_sample.shipped`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-sample-shipped) | You marked a sample as shipped. |
| [`campaign_sample.declined`](/webhooks/creator-campaigns/campaign-sample-declined) | You declined a sample request. |

## How it behaves

<Accordions>
<Accordion title="Every event is sent on the campaign's profile" id="every-event-is-sent-on-the-campaigns-profile">

A webhook or API key scoped to that profile receives them. Payloads carry no connected account id; `campaign.id`, `participant.id` and `creator.id` identify what changed.

</Accordion>
<Accordion title="Every event belongs to the `creator_campaigns` resource group" id="every-event-belongs-to-the-creator_campaigns-resource-group">

A restricted API key needs that group to subscribe.

</Accordion>
<Accordion title="Amounts are USD cents" id="amounts-are-usd-cents">

A payout event's `payableCents` is the balance after the event, not a delta.

</Accordion>
<Accordion title="Retries keep the event id" id="retries-keep-the-event-id">

Retries and redeliveries keep the event `id`. Dedupe on it before you pay anyone.

</Accordion>
</Accordions>
